title: Preceramic Adoption of Peanut, Squash, and Cotton in Northern Peru
lineage: Main article inspected in an online facsimile of the Science version of record at https://www.scribd.com/document/44077460/Dillehay-Et-Al-2007-Plantas-10000-aC and matched to PubMed PMID 17600214. The publisher blocked retrieval of the supplement.

passages.locator: p. 1891 and Fig. 5; p. 1892, Table 1, CA-09-71
passages.note: A cotton sample from a buried house floor at CA-09-71 dates to 6278–5948 cal BP. The phase interpretation invokes irrigation and a wider range of crops; the sample context is domestic.
The authors report peanut remains in both Las Pircas and Tierra Blanca contexts and additional quinoa-like chenopod specimens from Tierra Blanca sites.
